line: Prabhu, main Aries walon ki wakeel hun aur unka 2026 ka poora hisaab lekar aayi hun.
Itni lambi list hai, ye shikayat hai ya kisi shaadi ka menu hai?
Poore saal kharcha zyada hua, raat ko neend nahi aayi, aur jo share kharida wo turant gir gaya.
Shani dev abhi tumhare kharchon wale ghar mein baithe hain, isliye 2026 mein paisa aur neend dono hil gaye.
Arey baap re!
Toh kya 2027 bhi aisa hi jayega?
Ghabrao mat, isiliye toh mol-bhaav ho raha hai, bolo kya chahiye?
Abhi maza aayega na bhidu!
Pehli demand ye hai ki January se hi naya kaam shuru ho jaye.
Aries ke swami Mangal khud dus January se ek April tak vakri rahenge, isliye bade faisle April tak rok ke rakho.
Lekin ek second!
Aries wale teen mahine rukenge, aapko sach mein aisa lagta hai?
Yahi toh is saal ki asli pariksha hai, jo ruk gaya wahi jeetega.
Theek hai, toh 2027 mein Aries walon ko ghar mein poora sukoon dila dijiye.
June tak Guru ghar ke bhaav mein hain, par Ketu bhi wahin baithe hain, toh family ke liye waqt khud nikaalna padega.
Aur har function mein maasi poochti hain ki shaadi kab hogi, aur shaadi ho gayi toh good news kab aayegi.
Hey Bhagwan, kya karun main!
Haan, sun raha hun.
2026 mein Ketu ne pyaar aur bachchon ke maamle mein jo ulajhan di thi, June ke baad wahan Guru aa rahe hain, toh rishte ki baat aage badh sakti hai.
Aur last demand Prabhu, Sade Sati hi cancel kar dijiye na.
Wo Shani dev ka vibhag hai, wahan sifaarish nahi chalti, par 2027 mein June se October tak bas unki pehli dastak hai, aur Shani dev mehnat ka phal dete hain, darr ka nahi.
Tab tak neend aur sehat ka dhyaan rakho, aur ghabrao mat, Guru saath hain.
Matlab ek haan, ek aadha haan, ek mein intezaar aur ek pehli dastak, Aries ke liye toh ye bhi record hai!
Apne Aries dost ko ye bhejo, poori 2027 guide bio ke link mein hai, aur agli file Taurus ki hogi.
